headline: Foreigners Sell for 6 Straight Trading Days... Shopping Basket Filled with Refining, Airline and Financial Stocks
summary: Foreigners have net sold more than 11 trillion won of KOSPI shares over six trading days. They have bought bank, energy and refining stocks while selling semiconductors, with SK Innovation the top net buy.
why: Foreign investor flows are a key driver of South Korean equity prices, and banks, refiners and chipmakers are major sector weights in the KOSPI.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Sustained foreign net selling of more than 11 trillion won weighs on the index.
